subject.character: ONE garden snail, big in frame, grey-olive body, clear face, eyes on long stalks, small mouth; brown shell with a brass padlock and iron chain; same face throughout
subject.physicality: stalks snap in and out; skates on wet stone, slime glinting; lunges; skids sideways; hauls in jerks

second_characters: ONE fat banker, greasy suit, sleeve protectors, silent, rides the dragged desk
props: old cash register, blank keys, no digits; wooden work desk; long chain: the desk trails behind him; coin: smooth gold, no engraving; padlock: smooth brass
environment: wet stone garden step; dense background: wet leaves, moss, drops, clay pots
lighting: warm sun edge behind-left, cool cyan sky edge behind-right on both figures, glints on brass and gold, bright
motion_rule: The snail big. Camera orbits every beat and changes shot size, medium to close; background shifts with the orbit. He skates, skids or hauls every beat. The banker moves his whole body every beat.

audio.delivery: flat low brisk male voice, native, no accent; first word on frame one; stress VYgodny
audio.pacing: brisk, each line once inside its beat, nothing said after 5.7
audio.sfx: after 5.7 only chain clank, desk scrape, coin clink

timeline.a: mouth opens on every syllable; he skates across wet stone left to right as the fat banker lunges, slapping a gold coin onto the stone near frame edge; camera arcs left to right
mouth opens on every syllable; he skates toward the coin, stalks snapping out, as the banker sprawls, flicking it rolling to him; camera arcs right to left
mouth opens on every syllable; he rolls onto the coin and skids sideways, it sticks to his sole, as the banker yanks the chain; camera orbits with the skid
he skates off hard, jerking the desk round in an arc, shell bouncing, as the banker hauls the chain hand over hand; orbit against the jerk
mouth opens on every syllable; he lunges away, chain snapping taut, desk jolting, as the banker topples belly-first onto it; camera arcs
mouth opens on every syllable; he skids off sideways, drawer shooting open, as the banker scrambles astride the register; low arc
mouth opens on every syllable; he whips round, skating off with the desk, as the banker leans back hauling the chain; arc against the pull
mouth shut; he skids into a clay pot, the coin flying off his sole into the drawer, as the banker belly-slams it shut; arc with the skid
he hauls in a jerk up the step, desk lurching, as the banker is thrown backward, legs flying; camera orbits both
he skids round a pot, desk scraping a wide arc, as the banker swings out over the edge like a counterweight; orbit against the drag
he hauls over wet moss, as the banker jumps on the desk to brake; low arc
he skids round, as the banker pops the drawer, leans out, slaps the coin onto the stone ahead; orbit the other way
he skates after the coin, dragging the desk, as the banker lunges, flicking it further; arc

must_appear: 0.00 padlock and chain on shell; 1.90 coin sticks to his sole; 4.20 drawer opens; 5.70 coin into the drawer; 8.50 coin slapped ahead; final: snail chases the coin dragging the desk
